resolution: (1) Donghae-line KTX-Eum from Gangneung: 752 dep 09:36 arr Gyeongju 12:30 (2h54) / arr Bujeon 13:36; 754 dep 14:56 arr Gyeongju 17:44 / Bujeon 18:50; 756 dep 18:35 arr Gyeongju 21:22 / Bujeon 22:29. Fares 34,300 (Gangneung-Gyeongju) and 46,800 (Gangneung-Bujeon), adult general seat. Plus ITX-Maeum 1822 dep 05:46 arr Gyeongju 09:08 (24,800) / Bujeon 10:49 (34,900). Source: train.asamaru.net timetable for Oct 7-13 2026, identical every day that week (high confidence for that week; medium-high for Oct 21-23 because no timetable revision is announced, but the specific dates and live seat availability could NOT be read: korail.com search is a JavaScript app that does not render without a browser session). The Gyeongju arrival estimate of 12:20 is wrong: use 12:30. The service originates at Gangneung (news: 'departs Gangneung, stopping at Jeongdongjin, Mukho, Donghae, Samcheok, Uljin, Yeongdeok, Pohang, Gyeongju, Taehwagang to Bujeon'; high confidence). (2) The Donghae-line KTX-Eum started Dec 30, 2025, with 3 round trips a day (high confidence; Dec 15 2025 press reports). logistics.json's 'Dec 30 2024' is a year off. heritage.json's 'Dec 20 2024' refers to the Jungang-line KTX-Eum (Cheongnyangni-Andong-Gyeongju-Bujeon) starting to stop at Gyeongju. That is a different service and both statements can be true. (3) The booking window is 2 months before departure from Oct 1, 2026 (high confidence; SBS Biz Sep 20 2026 and Wikitree, a MOLIT/Korail announcement). The 1-month figure is the old rule. The opening hour (07:00) is the long-standing Korail practice and was not restated in the articles (medium). The point is moot for this trip: Oct 17-25 is already inside even the old 1-month window, so every train is on sale NOW and the group should book today, especially the 3-a-day KTX-Eum and the foliage-season weekend trains to Gangneung. (4) Canonical fares after the Sep 1 2026 KTX-SRT merger (about a 10% cut on high-speed KTX routes, guaranteed for 3 years): Seoul-Gyeongju 44,500 (KTX; 44,000 on KTX-Sancheon, 44,600 on KTX-Eum). heritage's 49,300 is the pre-cut fare. Gyeongju-Busan Station 10,100 (heritage's ~11,000 is pre-cut). Seoul-Busan 54,400 (was 59,800). Seoul-Gangneung 27,600, unchanged by the cut (standing 23,500). AREX Express: official fare 13,000 adult (walk-up 'regular fare' 18,500/19,100 is the theoretical undiscounted price). 11,000 is only a third-party voucher price (Klook/Trip.com/Waug), so plan with 13,000 and treat 11,000 as an optional saving. All high confidence. (5) The Gangneung-Samcheok Sea Train (바다열차) is NOT running: it was retired after its last run on Dec 26, 2023 (old rolling stock, no budget). Gangwon mentions a revival only as a future plan (July 2026). For a coastal ride, use the regular Donghae-line KTX-Eum, ITX-Maeum or Nuriro between Gangneung, Jeongdongjin and Samcheok, sitting on the left/east side heading south. High confidence.
